title: English Practice Quiz 0176
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: I ___ a new notebook yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday signals the past simple. The past form of buy is bought.

questions.question: What does 'borrow' mean?
options: take something temporarily and return it
questions.explanation: Borrow means to take something for a period and return it.

questions.question: Choose the correct plural of 'child'.
questions.explanation: Children is the irregular plural of child.

questions.question: The windows ___ every week.
questions.explanation: Plural subject windows takes are + past participle.
